title: Beside and Between
short: Say where something is: beside or between.

blocks.html: Beside means right next to. Between means in the middle, with one on each side. The cat is between the dog and the bunny!

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: Who is between the dog and the bunny?

blocks.html: Between means in the middle of two things.

For the grown-up: Sit between two stuffed animals. Put a spoon beside a cup. Ask your child to put a block between two others, then beside one. Keep screen time short: two or three problems, then play.

items: Try it at home: Sit between two pillows.
Put a toy beside your shoe.
Build a block row and ask what is between.
